heroHeadline: Iran Says Hormuz Stays Closed Until US Meets Seven Conditions
heroSubtitle: Day 220 (October 5, 2026): Parliament speaker Ghalibaf says the Strait of Hormuz will stay closed until the US accepts Iran's seven conditions based on the Islamabad memorandum, after Trump rejected Tehran's reopening proposal. Oil Minister Mohsen Paknejad resigned under the US blockade, with NIOC chief Hamid Bovard acting minister, and the rial hit new lows.
